unit_cn: Unit 5 On the Road 在路上
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 5 词表(p49-57 真词)+ 旅行主题常见课标词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、旅行/在路上主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Our next destination is a small mountain village by the lake.
words.example_cn: 我们的下一个目的地是湖边的一个山村。

words.example_en: The bus follows a scenic route along the coast.
words.example_cn: 这辆巴士沿海岸走一条风景优美的路线。

words.example_en: The journey across Canada took us two whole weeks.
words.example_cn: 横穿加拿大的旅程花了我们整整两周。

words.example_en: In Vancouver we picked up our vehicle, a home on wheels.
words.example_cn: 在温哥华我们取了车,一辆轮子上的家。

words.example_en: Our flight to Jakarta leaves early in the morning.
words.example_cn: 我们飞往雅加达的航班一大早就起飞。

words.meaning_cn: 在(船/飞机/火车)上;上(车/船/飞机)
words.example_en: Passengers aboard the train enjoyed the mountain views.
words.example_cn: 火车上的乘客欣赏着群山的景色。

words.example_en: Matt arranged the transfer from the airport to the hotel.
words.example_cn: 马特安排了从机场到酒店的接送。

words.example_en: Don't forget to pack your luggage the night before the trip.
words.example_cn: 别忘了在出发前一晚打包行李。

words.example_en: We booked the hotel based on the budget we had made.
words.example_cn: 我们根据制定的预算订了酒店。

words.example_en: Remember to exchange some foreign currency before you leave.
words.example_cn: 记得在出发前兑换一些外币。

words.example_en: I am taking three hundred dollars in cash to buy souvenirs.
words.example_cn: 我带三百美元现金去买纪念品。

words.example_en: I would rather pay by credit card than carry much cash.
words.example_cn: 我宁愿刷信用卡也不愿带太多现金。

words.example_en: She bought a small souvenir for her family in each city.
words.example_cn: 她在每座城市都为家人买了一个小纪念品。

words.example_en: We can get a visa when we arrive at the airport.
words.example_cn: 我们可以在抵达机场时办理签证。

words.example_en: I checked the embassy website about the visa rules.
words.example_cn: 我查了大使馆网站上的签证规定。

words.example_en: We stayed in a hotel chain that is clean and cheap.
words.example_cn: 我们住在一家干净又便宜的连锁酒店。

words.example_en: The landscape along the route was beautiful and dramatic.
words.example_cn: 沿途的风景优美而壮观。

words.example_en: The mountain scenery from the train window was amazing.
words.example_cn: 从火车车窗看到的山间景色令人惊叹。

words.meaning_cn: 激动人心的;给人深刻印象的
words.example_en: The coast offered dramatic views of cliffs and waves.
words.example_cn: 海岸呈现出悬崖与海浪的壮观景象。

words.example_en: Adventure travellers love exploring remote places.
words.example_cn: 爱冒险的旅行者喜欢探索偏远之地。

words.example_en: They crossed the whole continent from west to east.
words.example_cn: 他们从西到东横穿了整个大陆。

words.example_en: We hiked near an active volcano on the island.
words.example_cn: 我们在岛上一座活火山附近徒步。

words.example_en: We hiked all day and even saw some huge yaks.
words.example_cn: 我们徒步走了一整天,甚至看到了一些巨大的牦牛。

words.example_en: Cultural tourists often visit the local gallery and museums.
words.example_cn: 文化游客常去当地的美术馆和博物馆。

words.example_en: Many young people dream of travelling abroad one day.
words.example_cn: 许多年轻人梦想有一天能出国旅行。

words.example_en: Thousands of tourists visit the old town every year.
words.example_cn: 每年有成千上万的游客参观这座古镇。

words.example_en: Food tourism means choosing a place for its food.
words.example_cn: 美食旅游是指为了美食而选择目的地。

words.example_en: An adventure to the islands of Hawaii sounds wonderful.
words.example_cn: 一场去夏威夷群岛的冒险听起来很棒。

words.example_en: Andrew helped to arrange the whole trip for us.
words.example_cn: 安德鲁帮我们安排了整个行程。

words.example_en: You should exchange foreign currency before the flight.
words.example_cn: 你应该在航班起飞前兑换外币。

words.example_en: On her blog she listed her previous job as a chef.
words.example_cn: 在博客上她写明自己以前的工作是厨师。

words.example_en: She chose a different profession and became a photographer.
words.example_cn: 她选择了另一种职业,成了摄影师。

words.example_en: Lauren quit her job as a chef to follow her dream.
words.example_cn: 劳伦辞去了厨师的工作去追寻梦想。

words.example_en: Adventure tourists often engage in risky activities.
words.example_cn: 冒险游客常从事一些有风险的活动。

words.example_en: The Kimberley region is unique and almost untouched.
words.example_cn: 金伯利地区独特而几乎未被开发。

words.example_en: As a photographer, she loves bright light and colours.
words.example_cn: 作为摄影师,她热爱明亮的光线和色彩。

words.example_en: She became Australia's first professional travel blogger.
words.example_cn: 她成了澳大利亚首位职业旅行博主。

words.example_en: You can experience the indigenous culture there.
words.example_cn: 你可以在那里体验当地的原住民文化。

words.example_en: All we saw in the mountains was a small group of deer.
words.example_cn: 我们在山里看到的只有一小群鹿。

words.example_en: There were forests, snowy peaks and masses of ice.
words.example_cn: 那里有森林、雪峰和大量的冰。

words.example_en: Ice hockey is more popular than soccer in Canada.
words.example_cn: 在加拿大,冰球比足球更受欢迎。

words.example_en: I try to take every opportunity to get outside.
words.example_cn: 我尽量抓住每一个机会到户外去。

words.example_en: He booked accommodation that was clean and central.
words.example_cn: 他订了干净又位于市中心的住处。

words.example_en: Print your boarding pass before you board the plane.
words.example_cn: 在登机前打印好你的登机牌。

words.example_en: Check that your passport and visa are ready before leaving.
words.example_cn: 出发前查看你的护照和签证是否备好。

words.example_en: Travellers explore unusual and remote destinations.
words.example_cn: 旅行者会探索一些不寻常的偏远目的地。

words.example_en: She enjoys photographing animals such as dolphins and kangaroos.
words.example_cn: 她喜欢拍摄海豚和袋鼠等动物。

words.example_en: She once photographed a crocodile swimming close to the boat.
words.example_cn: 她曾拍下一条游近船边的鳄鱼。
